newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Feb core inflation rises to 7.9pct - economist.
newsitem.headline: Greek Feb core inflation rises to 7.9pct - economist.

text.p: Greece's core consumer price inflation, which does not include volatile food and energy prices, increased to 7.9 percent year-on-year in February from 7.5 percent in January, according to estimates by an economist at a foreign bank here.
The National Statistics Service (NSS) does not release core inflation but the central bank and the national economy ministry are known to monitor it.
The economist, who does not want to be named, estimated the core inflation using official inflation data on food, energy and the CPI index.

Headline CPI-based inflation eased to 6.6 percent year-on-year in February from 6.8 percent in January meaning that the gap between core and headline inflation rates widened. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
